summary: All 8 acceptance criteria covered by 8 named browser checks; all passed. No API-bearing criteria exist (booking form is explicitly local-only with no backend endpoint), so no backend pytest artifacts were required.

checks.criterion: All public routes and custom 404 are complete and reachable
checks.name: routes-and-404-complete
checks.evidence: Navigated to /, /services, /workshop, /about, /gallery, /visit-us, /contact, /book-service (each has 1 H1); /book -> /book-service and /visit -> /visit-us redirects confirmed via URL assertion; unknown route shows branded 404 with Home/Services/Visit links visible. Ran against APP_URL https://als-royal-enfield.preview.emergentagent.com.

checks.criterion: Route-specific SEO and structured data are correct
checks.name: seo-metadata-per-route
checks.evidence: Home: 1 H1, unique title/description, canonical ending '/', og:title, twitter:card, JSON-LD containing WebSite/WebPage/AutomotiveBusiness present. Services: unique title/description vs Home, self canonical '/services', BreadcrumbList JSON-LD present. 404 route has meta robots content containing 'noindex'.

checks.criterion: Crawler and brand assets are public
checks.name: crawler-and-brand-assets-public
checks.evidence: GET /sitemap.xml -> 200 with <urlset>; /robots.txt -> 200 with Sitemap: directive; /llms.txt -> 200 containing 'ALS Royal Enfield' and no framework branding strings; /als-mark.svg -> 200 with svg content-type.

checks.criterion: Local-only service enquiry form is hardened
checks.name: booking-form-validation-and-local-success
checks.evidence: Blank submit shows role=alert error (booking-form-error). Valid name/phone/email/bike model/service/date/message submission shows booking-success-state. Monitored all page requests during interaction: zero requests matched /api/, confirming no customer data was sent to any API.

checks.criterion: Navigation and internal linking work on mobile
checks.name: mobile-navigation-accessible
checks.evidence: 390x844 viewport: no horizontal overflow on / or /book-service (scrollWidth-clientWidth <= 2px). mobile-menu-toggle-button toggles aria-expanded true/false and mobile-navigation-panel mounts/unmounts; mobile-book-service-link navigates to /book-service and booking-form renders.

checks.name: gallery-filter-and-lightbox-accessible
checks.evidence: Filtering to 'Workshop' reduced visible tile count vs 'All'. Opening a tile shows gallery-lightbox-dialog with gallery-lightbox-image having a descriptive alt attribute (>=5 chars); Escape key closes the dialog (count 0).

checks.criterion: Business facts and conversion links are accurate
checks.name: business-facts-and-conversion-links-accurate
checks.evidence: /contact shows both formatted phones (90076 92978, 97486 15101), all tel: links restricted to {9007692978, 9748615101}, address contains 700104 and Thakurpukur, directions link target=_blank with href containing Joka/Mahatma+Gandhi+Rd. /visit-us shows Monday-Saturday 10:30 AM-7:30 PM and Sunday 10:30 AM-3:00 PM.

checks.criterion: No broken assets or browser errors
checks.name: no-broken-assets-or-console-errors
checks.evidence: Navigated /, /gallery, /book-service: zero failed network requests, zero image responses >=400, all gallery elements have naturalWidth > 0 (not broken), zero non-DevTools console errors captured.

action_items: No API-bearing criterion exists in this app (booking is explicitly local-only per spec_deviations), so no backend pytest artifact was created this iteration -- by design, not an omission.
